item.title: AI Agents Have Two Souls. You Only Control One.
item.content:encoded: Why the code around your LLM matters more than the LLM itself: the architectural insight that changed how I think about AI agent security.

item.title: Integrating Resend with Auth0 for Email Delivery
item.content:encoded: Learn how to use Resend and React Email in your Auth0 transactional emails. Build component-based templates and integrate them seamlessly with Auth0 using configuration and Actions.

item.title: Auth for MCP Is Now Generally Available
item.content:encoded: Secure your Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with Auth0. Implement authentication, CIMD registration, and OBO token exchange for your AI agents.

item.title: Secure Your Spring Boot API with Auth0 in Minutes
item.content:encoded: Secure your Spring Boot API in minutes using the new Auth0 Spring Boot starter. Includes built-in DPoP support to stop stolen-token replay attacks.

item.title: A Developer's Guide to Flexible Token Exchange on Auth0
item.content:encoded: Explore Custom Token Exchange on Auth0, a standards-based flow for exchanging "foreign" tokens for trusted Auth0 tokens.

item.title: Driving Business Outcomes with Auth0 Inbound SCIM and Event Streams
item.content:encoded: Learn how to build a real-time identity-to-revenue pipeline using Auth0 Inbound SCIM and Event Streams to sync user data to CRMs without external middleware.

item.title: Moving From Social Login to Enterprise SSO, a Hybrid Auth Guide for Developers
item.content:encoded: Learn how to transition your SaaS from social logins to Enterprise SSO using Auth0 Organizations and SCIM for automated user management.

item.title: Build Real-Time Identity Pipelines with Auth0 Event Streams - Now Generally Available
item.content:encoded: Event Streams enables real-time identity events delivery, replacing fragile batch jobs with reliable, event-driven architecture for developers.

item.title: Auth0 is Now Available in the Stripe Projects Developer Preview
item.content:encoded: Learn how developers and agents can provision and manage services, including Auth0, from the Stripe CLI.

item.title: Is Your Auth Ready for AI? Why Identity Is the First Thing Developers Need to Fix
item.content:encoded: Learn why identity infrastructure is the primary bottleneck for scaling AI agents and how to move toward a secure, AI-ready auth model.
